paraphrase: Against the inference 'the world in question is false because it is perceivable, like (the silver in mother-of-pearl)': its subject is unestablished; its qualifier 'indeterminable' (anirvacanīya) is unestablished; if falsity meant only 'other than real and unreal' the inference would prove what is accepted; the probans 'perceivable' fails, and there is no agreeing example. The world's reality is established by perception, scripture and the witness.
speaker: Madhva
